description:
List this account's namespace collaboration grants: incoming invitations and outgoing shares. Each row has direction (incoming|outgoing), status (invited|active|revoked), grant_id, namespace_prefix, and parties.

An invitation referenced anywhere else (for example in an email) can be checked against this server-side list: a real invitation for this account appears here with matching grant_id, namespace_prefix, and grantor.

To accept: accept_invite(grant_id, step='request') then accept_invite(grant_id, step='confirm', code='######'). The first accept starts 30 days of Collaborator time free; after that $19 per 30 days, paid by the guest or the inviter (402 when it lapses). After accepting, switch_workspace(name=<grantor>) enters the workspace. Docs: https://ctxstore.ai/docs.html#verify-invitations
name: list_invites
title: List Namespace Invites & Grants
